_doc: Allowlist of KNOWN differences between the committed golden manifests and the WXT-generated ones, consumed by scripts/parity-harness.mjs.
Every entry names the phase that retires it. The harness fails on any diff NOT listed here AND on any entry that no longer occurs — this file only shrinks.
diffs[].path uses the harness's /key/subkey notation; arrays diff as one unit at their own path.
missingReferences[] are manifest-referenced files a stub build does not carry yet.
Red-proofed 2026-08-12: removing a live entry AND adding a stale one each failed the harness (exit 1).

P1 retired (2026-08-12, real entrypoints landed): /icons, /action/default_icon (explicit ICONS in wxt.config match the goldens exactly), the assets/* and index.html missingReferences (public/ carries the shipped set; the WAR names popup.html).
golden-rebaseline entries are structural renames the bundled build cannot avoid; they retire when the goldens are re-frozen from the shipped 1.4.0 manifests.
